title: Exploring the Potential of Diffusion Large Language Models in Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2509.11252v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs have become the mainstream approaches to code generation. Existing LLMs mainly employ autoregressive generation, i.e. generating code token-by-token from left to right. However, the underlying autoregressive generation has two limitations in code generation. First, autoregressive LLMs only generate a token at each step, showing low efficiency in practice. Second, programming is a non-sequential process involving back-and-forth editing, while autoregressive LLMs only employ the left-to-right generation order. These two intrinsic limitations hinder the further development of LLMs in code generation. Recently, diffusion LLMs have emerged as a promising alternative. Diffusion LLMs address the above limitations with two advances, including multi-token prediction (i.e. generating multiple tokens at each step) and flexible generation order (i.e. flexibly determining which positions to generate tokens). translated_title: 探索扩散大语言模型在代码生成中的潜力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已成为代码生成的主流方法。现有的LLMs主要采用自回归生成方式，即从左到右逐个token生成代码。然而，这种底层的自回归生成方式在代码生成中存在两个局限性：首先，自回归LLMs每次只能生成一个token，实际应用中效率较低；其次，编程是一个涉及反复前后编辑的非顺序过程，而自回归LLMs仅采用从左到右的生成顺序。这两个内在限制阻碍了LLMs在代码生成领域的进一步发展。最近，扩散LLMs作为一种有前景的替代方案应运而生。扩散LLMs通过两项进展解决了上述限制，包括多token预测（即每次生成多个token）和灵活的生成顺序（即灵活确定在哪些位置生成token）。然而，目前尚无系统性……
tldr: 扩散大语言模型凭借多token预测和灵活生成顺序两大优势，有望克服自回归大语言模型在代码生成中效率低、生成顺序固定等固有局限。
